title: cliffordia bicolor
intro: Cliffordia bicolor, commonly known as the "Moonflower", is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region. The Moonflower is known for its bright yellow and white flowers, which bloom in the evening and remain open throughout the night. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Cliffordia bicolor include sedative and antidepressant effects, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
